bounded_host_request.command:
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
v=0
test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || v=$((v+1))
git -C "$p" symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD >/dev/null || v=$((v+2))
git -C "$p" cat-file -e '70689ec0fdb9201742625d5d8a0054feeb31320d^{commit}' 2>/dev/null || v=$((v+4))
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 grep -Fq DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE /app/server/main.js || v=$((v+8))
git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD | grep -qx 70689ec0fdb9201742625d5d8a0054feeb31320d || v=$((v+16))
exit "$v"
